hero.description: Choose the latest trends from your own closet. Our AI stylist analyzes your wardrobe and creates perfect outfits for every occasion.

step1.title: Upload Your Closet
step1.description: Add photos of your clothes, shoes, and accessories. Organize by category, color, and season.

step2.title: Describe Your Look
step2.description: Tell our AI what you need: casual dinner? Professional meeting? The AI understands context.

step3.title: See It On You
step3.description: Try each outfit live with your camera before deciding.

why.description: We combine artificial intelligence with personal styling to help you make the most of what you already own.

features.uses_what_desc: No new purchases. Works exclusively with your existing wardrobe.
features.ai_fashion_desc: Considers occasion, style, weather, and current trends.
features.options_desc: Multiple looks so you can pick the one you love most.
features.tryon_live: Try it live with your camera
features.tryon_live_desc: The AR virtual try-on shows every look on your body in real time — no photos or avatars needed.

cta.description: Upload your clothes today and have your first outfit ready in 5 minutes.
